capabilities: Upload pasted and drag-and-dropped media to S3-compatible storage
Generate links for images, videos and audio
Return download links for unsupported file types
Delete unused resources from the bucket
extras: README is developer-oriented (clone, npm install, build, manual copy) with no end-user installation or configuration instructions; several features are listed as incomplete or unplanned.
problem: Obsidian stores media attachments inside the local vault, and there is no built-in way to offload them to external object storage to keep the vault small.
summary: Uploads media attachments to S3-compatible storage and generates links for images, videos and audio in notes.
